author: theglobalpharm
caption: How to prevent razor bumps after shaving 🪒 If you constantly get razor bumps, shaving bumps, ingrown hairs or skin irritation after shaving, your pre-shave routine might be worth looking at. One thing I recommend discussing with your skincare professional is gentle exfoliation before shaving.  🪒 Products containing exfoliating acids such as glycolic acid or lactic acid may help remove dead skin cells, while properly preparing the hair and skin before shaving can make the shaving process gentler. My basic shaving routine: ✨ Gently exfoliate beforehand 🪒 Soften the hair and skin before shaving 🧴 Use shaving cream or gel ➡️ Shave gently in the direction of hair growth 💧 Moisturize afterwards with a shower gel and moisturizing deodorant.  And please don’t automatically reach for strong combination creams every time you get shaving irritation.  The right approach depends on what’s actually causing your bumps. Save this for your next shave and send it to someone who always gets razor bumps!
